title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant Finance Assistant Accounts Administrator

Crewe £27,000-£30,000 Full-time Permanent

Introduction

Acorn by Synergie is recruiting for an organised and detail-oriented Accounts Assistant to join a busy and growing business based in Crewe.

This is a varied opportunity supporting the finance function with day-to-day accounting activities and ensuring financial records are accurate and up to date.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Finance team and wider business, providing essential support across sales ledger, purchase ledger and general accounts administration.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing supplier invoices and managing the purchase ledger.
- Raising sales invoices and maintaining the sales ledger.
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving invoice queries.
- Carrying out credit control and monitoring outstanding customer balances.
- Completing bank reconciliations and daily cash allocation.
- Processing payments and assisting with payment runs.
- Managing employee expenses and credit card reconciliations.
- Assisting with month-end procedures and reporting.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and filing systems.
- Supporting the wider Finance team with ad-hoc administrative duties as required.

Requirements
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or similar accounting role.
- Experience with sales ledger, purchase ledger and bank reconciliations.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Experience using accounting software such as Sage, Xero or similar packages.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Organised, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong communication skills and a proactive approach to work.

Desirable
- AAT qualification or currently studying towards AAT.
- Experience working within a fast-paced commercial environment.

What We Offer
- Full-time, permanent position.
- Competitive salary of £27,000-£30,000.
- Supportive and friendly working environment.
- Opportunity for training and professional development.

Interested?

If you're an experienced Accounts Assistant or Finance Assistant looking for your next opportunity in Crewe, apply today to find out more.

Acorn by Synergie acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment.

MACCLESFIELD, CHESHIRE
UP TO £26,500 + EXCELLENT BENEFITS

- Excellent attention to detail with strong numerical and analytical skills
- Confident communicating with customers and internal departments via telephone and email

description:

MACCLESFIELD, CHESHIRE
UP TO 29,200 + EXCELLENT BENEFITS

THE OPPORTUNITY:
We're partnering with a well-established and growing business in Macclesfield that is looking to recruit an experienced Credit Controller to join its successful finance team.
The successful Credit Controller will take ownership of an extensive customer ledger, focusing on maximising cash collection, reducing outstanding debt and managing customer relationships.
You'll be joining an established team within a fast-paced business that boasts an impressive portfolio of clients, where you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact on cash flow and financial performance.

THE CREDIT CONTROLLER ROLE:
- Managing an extensive customer ledger, ensuring outstanding debts are collected efficiently and within agreed payment terms
- Proactively contacting customers by telephone and email to chase overdue payments and reduce aged debt
- Building strong relationships with customers to encourage prompt payment and resolve outstanding queries
- Handling challenging conversations with customers professionally and confidently to secure payment commitments
- Monitoring customer accounts, identifying overdue balances and escalating potential financial risks
- Investigating and resolving payment discrepancies, outstanding invoices and customer account queries
- Working towards strict cash collection targets, SLAs and KPIs to support the achievement of financial objectives
- Maintaining accurate records of customer communications, payment arrangements and collection activity
- Liaising with internal departments to resolve disputes and ensure outstanding balances are collected
- Supporting the wider credit control team with debt reduction initiatives and improvements to collection processes

title: Payroll Administrator
company: McLennan Knight Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Payroll Administrator

Own your client portfolio. Build genuine relationships. Be the payroll expert clients rely on.

We're working with a well-established and growing business looking for an experienced Payroll Administrator to manage a portfolio of weekly payroll clients from start to finish. This is far more than a processing role. You'll become the trusted point of contact for your clients, providing expert payroll support and building long-term relationships.

If you enjoy taking ownership, solving problems, and delivering an outstanding client experience, this could be the perfect opportunity.

The role

As Payroll Administrator, you will:
- Manage a portfolio of weekly payroll clients, acting as their primary point of contact.
- Process end-to-end payrolls, including starters, leavers, PAYE, pensions, statutory payments, P45s and P60s.
- Complete HMRC submissions and ensure payrolls are accurate and compliant.
- Support clients with payroll legislation updates, including IR35 and off-payroll working requirements.
- Resolve complex payroll queries confidently and professionally.
- Share knowledge with colleagues and contribute to continuous improvement across payroll processes and systems.

What we're looking for:
- A minimum of 2 years' experience processing end-to-end payrolls.
- Weekly payroll experience would be highly advantageous.
- Strong customer service skills with a proactive, ownership-focused approach.
- Good understanding of payroll legislation, PAYE, pensions, VAT and gross margin calculations.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Strong attention to detail with the ability to remain calm and organised under pressure.
- CIPP qualification is desirable, but not essential.

What's in it for you?
- Genuine ownership of your own client portfolio.
- A varied role combining payroll expertise with account management responsibilities.
- Supportive and experienced colleagues who are available when needed.
- Ongoing training and development to keep your payroll knowledge up to date.
- The opportunity to join a growing business where your contribution is genuinely valued.
